display.purpose: Featured novel title on the home page only; 1.875rem mobile, 2.25rem sm, 3rem md.

title.purpose: Novel titles in lists, grids and the continue strip; accent on hover.

wordmark.purpose: Site name in header, drawer and footer.

prose.purpose: Chapter reading text; size user-adjustable via --reader-font-size; justified desktop, left-aligned 16.5px/2.1 under 640px.

label.purpose: Muted metadata, dates (tabular figures), quiet links.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled accent action per view, e.g. start reading.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Noto Sans Sinhala', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; background: var(--theme-accent, #0F766E); color: var(--theme-accent-text, #ffffff); transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--theme-accent-hover, #115E59); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--theme-accent, #0F766E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Link
components.description: Secondary action beside the primary button, and section-level links.
components.css: .ds-link-quiet { font-family: 'Noto Sans Sinhala', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; color: var(--reader-muted, #64748b); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-link-quiet:hover { color: var(--reader-text, #22252a); } .ds-link-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--theme-accent, #0F766E); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Header
components.description: Sticky slim header: serif wordmark, plain nav, icon actions right, bottom hairline.
components.html:
කතා අරණ
නවකතාප්‍රභේදකතුවරුන්
components.css: .ds-header { height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--reader-bg, #fcfbf9); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--reader-border, #e2e8f0); color: var(--reader-text, #22252a); } .ds-wordmark { font-family: 'Noto Serif Sinhala', 'Lora', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-wordmark:hover { color: var(--theme-accent, #0F766E); } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; font-family: 'Noto Sans Sinhala', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--reader-muted, #64748b); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--reader-text, #22252a); } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { color: var(--reader-text, #22252a); font-weight: 600; } .ds-icon-btn { margin-left: auto; padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--reader-muted, #64748b); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color: var(--reader-text, #22252a); } .ds-header a:focus-visible, .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--theme-accent, #0F766E); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Cover Tile
components.description: Frameless 2:3 cover with serif title and muted metadata; the shadow appears only on hover.
components.html: නවකතාවේ නමකතුවරයාපරිච්ඡේද 12 · ලියවෙමින්
components.css: .ds-cover-tile { display: block; width: 160px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--reader-text, #22252a); } .ds-cover { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #3b5b6b, #1d2b33); transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-cover-tile:hover .ds-cover { box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-cover-title { display: block; margin-top: 12px; font-family: 'Noto Serif Sinhala', 'Lora', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.375; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-cover-tile:hover .ds-cover-title { color: var(--theme-accent, #0F766E); } .ds-cover-meta { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans Sinhala', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--reader-muted, #64748b); } .ds-cover-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--theme-accent, #0F766E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chapter Row
components.description: Hairline-separated latest-chapter row: thumbnail, serif title, muted chapter line, tabular date.
components.html:
1. නවකතාවේ නමපරිච්ඡේදය 4: මාතෘකාවනොවැ 8
  2. තවත් නවකතාවක්පරිච්ඡේදය 9: මාතෘකාවනොවැ 6
components.css: .ds-rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-rows li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--reader-border, #e2e8f0); } .ds-rows li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 0; text-decoration: none; color: var(--reader-text, #22252a); } .ds-thumb { width: 40px; height: 60px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #6b4a3b, #2b1d16); } .ds-row-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-row-title { display: block; font-family: 'Noto Serif Sinhala', 'Lora', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-title { color: var(--theme-accent, #0F766E); } .ds-row-sub, .ds-row-date { display: block; font-family: 'Noto Sans Sinhala', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--reader-muted, #64748b); } .ds-row-date { flex-shrink: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--theme-accent, #0F766E); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The category standard, executed cleanly: reading-platform patterns from Webnovel and Wattpad (featured novel, latest chapters, a cover grid) held in the text-first quiet of Medium and Substack. Everything sits directly on the page ground. Structure comes from hairline dividers and whitespace, never from boxes. The interface is near-monochrome so the novel covers can carry all the colour; a single teal accent marks the one action that matters.

Density is calm and editorial: one centred 64rem column, generous vertical rhythm, Sinhala text with tall line heights. The same page must read correctly in four themes (light, sepia, dark, AMOLED), so every surface colour comes from the theme variables, not from fixed values.
keyCharacteristics: Page ground only; no cards, panels, pills or stat grids.
1px hairline dividers in the theme border colour separate sections and list rows.
One accent, on the primary button, hover/active title states, focus rings and the bookmark count.
Serif (Noto Serif Sinhala) for titles and the wordmark; sans (Noto Sans Sinhala) for UI, synopsis and reading prose.
Covers at 2:3 are the only colourful objects on the page.

rules.name: The Covers Carry Colour Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays ink-on-paper. Colour on the page comes from cover art and the single accent; no tinted section backgrounds, coloured badges or gradient fills.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent appears on at most one filled element per view (the primary button). Everywhere else it is text colour on hover or active, or a focus outline.

rules.name: The Serif Names Things Rule
rules.body: Serif is for titles of works and section heads; never for buttons, nav or metadata.

rules.name: The Only Books Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to cover images. Text, buttons, lists and navigation stay flat.

dos: Do place content directly on the page ground and separate it with 1px hairlines in the theme border colour.
Do use the theme variables (`--reader-*`, `--theme-accent*`) for every colour so all four themes work.
Do keep the accent to the primary button, hover and active title states, focus rings and the bookmark count.
Do set titles of works in Noto Serif Sinhala and everything else in Noto Sans Sinhala, with tall Sinhala line heights (1.95 for synopsis, 2.15 for prose).
Do show covers at 2:3 and let them be the colour on the page.
donts: Don't wrap content in bordered or rounded panels, cards, genre or status pills, or stat grids (the bookmark count is the only badge).
Don't add a second accent colour, tinted section backgrounds or gradients.
Don't put shadows on anything except cover images.
Don't hard-code hex colours in markup; they break sepia, dark and AMOLED.
